'''Gaarx''' was one of the only [[Tchuukthai]] ever to be seen off the [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].

==Behind the scenes==
Gaarx was first introduced as a sample name for a Tchuukthai in a [[Wizards of the Coast]] online Web Enhancement. ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' later included an entry for Gaarx as an actual individual.
